answer_1.quote: we employ Gemini-1.5-Pro to generate captions in the standardized format... we generate 2,000 multiple-choice QA pairs across five categories
answer_1.outputs: video captions and multiple-choice QA pairs

answer_2.quote: We followed the prompting approach... used accuracy as the metric. For ActivityNet-QA... utilized GPT-4o to calculate accuracy. We measure the GSB score, i.e., the percentage of "Good" and "Same" relative to that of "Bad" and "Same".

answer_3.quote: In Caption Evaluation, where the model generates a caption for each video, and an LLM (Gemini-1.5-Pro) answers questions based on this caption... we used GPT-4o to calculate accuracy.
methods: Caption Evaluation using LLM answering QA

answer_4.quote: All of the above machine annotation results undergo review and refinement by human annotators. Five human annotators assess the semantic relevance between videos generated by two captions, classifying them as "Good", "Same", or "Bad".
answer_4.guideline: Annotators classify generated videos as Good, Same, or Bad based on semantic relevance to the original video.
